title: Push-forward domination by Borel integrands extends to a.e.-measurable integrands (null-set transport; steps 1, 3, 7 of the height transfer)
statement: Let n, l >= 0. Let nu be a measure on R^n (Rn n) and mu a measure on R^(n+l) (Amb n l), both spaces with their Borel sigma-algebras, and let F : R^n -> R^(n+l) be nu-a.e.-measurable (AEMeasurable F nu). Assume (E): for every Borel measurable h : R^(n+l) -> [0, infinity], the lower Lebesgue integral of h(F(x)) d nu(x) is at most the lower Lebesgue integral of h d mu. Then for every g : R^(n+l) -> [0, infinity] that is mu-a.e.-measurable (AEMeasurable g mu), the lower integral of g(F(x)) d nu(x) is at most the lower integral of g d mu. (Lower integrals are Mathlib's lintegral, defined for arbitrary [0, infinity]-valued functions.)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Rn n)) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (F : Rn n → Amb n ℓ), AEMeasurable F ν → (∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ x, g (F x) ∂ν ≤ ∫⁻ y, g y ∂μ) → ∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, AEMeasurable g μ → ∫⁻ x, g (F x) ∂ν ≤ ∫⁻ y, g y ∂μ
